request.requested_format: pseudonymised data in a secure processing environment
request.purpose: Policy-making: planning the number of specialist outpatient clinics per region for the next health plan.
request.question: How many patients with heart failure have no active loop diuretic, per hospital?
definitions: Heart failure = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I50.
Loop diuretic = ATC code starting with C03CA.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per hospital: patients with heart failure, how many of them have no active loop diuretic and that share in %, one decimal.
